artists.biography: Held By Trees is an instrumental post-rock collaboration of musicians from the United Kingdom. The music is heavily inspired by Talk Talk and Mark Hollis. Many musicians that took part in the infamous sessions for Talk Talk's Spirit of Eden (1988) and Laughing Stock (1991), as well as Mark Hollis' solo album (1998), collaborated on Held By Trees' début LP, Solace (2022). Other inspirations include the minimal piano work of Ryuichi Sakamoto and early 1970s Pink Floyd. Read more on Last.fm. perplexity.description:
Hinterland, released in April 2025 by Held By Trees on Lasgo Records, marks the group’s second full-length album and a return to their instrumental roots after a series of vocal collaborations and live recordings. The album is characterized by its blend of ambient textures and heavier, more atmospheric passages, moving beyond the pastoral tone of their acclaimed 2022 debut Solace. Drawing on electronic and post-rock influences, Hinterland explores themes of ambiguity and emotional depth, with layered soundscapes that balance delicacy and intensity.

Musically, Hinterland features contributions from a notable roster of musicians, including Charlie Hollis (son of Mark Hollis) on piano, Rob Coombes of Supergrass, Matt Simms of Wire, Norman Westberg of Swans, and others, lending the album a rich, collaborative feel. The sound is both expansive and introspective, reflecting the group’s ongoing evolution while maintaining their signature atmospheric style. The album was well-received for its ambitious scope and nuanced production, solidifying Held By Trees’ reputation as a leading act in the contemporary electronic and ambient scene.
